description: This is a test source file for GatewaySettingsStore, containing unit tests that verify the persistence, migration, and update mechanisms of gateway settings and related keychain and user defaults storage.

classes.name: GatewaySettingsStoreTests
classes.description: A suite of test cases for GatewaySettingsStore to verify its correct behavior in handling defaults, keychain storage, migration, and updating gateway settings.

methods.name: bootstrapCopiesDefaultsToKeychainWhenMissing
methods.description: Tests that the bootstrap persists default values into the keychain when the keychain entries are missing.

methods.name: bootstrapCopiesKeychainToDefaultsWhenMissing
methods.description: Tests that default values from the keychain are restored into user defaults when missing.

methods.name: lastGateway_manualRoundTrip
methods.description: Verifies the manual saving and loading of the last gateway connection, ensuring data integrity.

methods.name: lastGateway_discoveredOverwritesManual
methods.description: Checks that a discovered gateway connection overwrites a manually set one.

methods.name: lastGateway_migratesFromUserDefaults
methods.description: Ensures migration from legacy UserDefaults keys to keychain storage for last gateway info and cleans up old keys.

methods.name: talkProviderApiKey_genericRoundTrip
methods.description: Tests saving and retrieving of Talk provider API keys from keychain, including removal.
